Identified as this saint because: Found by reading the Commons category off Wikidata — Q2465485, «Tryphon of Vyatka», a Russian abbot and saint — which gives `Category:Tryphon of Vyatka`. The file's title carries the by-name, «Трифон Вятский», which is this folder's own saint: display name «Tryphon of Vyatka», the abbot and wonderworker kept 8 October in the Russian and Greek calendars. The category's bare-titled «Икона Трифон.jpg» was NOT taken: Tryphon of Campsada is a different and far commoner Tryphon, and only the file carrying «Вятский» rules him out. 4145x3869.
